versos.hebraico: דִּבְרֵ֤י׀ אָג֥וּר בִּן־יָקֶ֗ה הַמַּ֫שָּׂ֥א נְאֻ֣ם הַ֭גֶּבֶר לְאִֽיתִיאֵ֑ל לְאִ֖יתִיאֵ֣ל וְאֻכָֽל׃

controles.web: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the oracle:  the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:
controles.kjv: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,
controles.livre: Palavras de Agur, filho de Jaque, o de fala solene; Este homem diz a Itiel; a Itiel e a Ucal:

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י בַ֣עַר אָנֹכִ֣י מֵאִ֑ישׁ וְלֹֽא־בִינַ֖ת אָדָ֣ם לִֽי׃

controles.web: “Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.
controles.kjv: Surely I am more brutish than any man, and have not the understanding of a man.
controles.livre: Certamente eu sou o mais bruto dos homens, e não tenho entendimento humano.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹֽא־לָמַ֥דְתִּי חָכְמָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת קְדֹשִׁ֣ים אֵדָֽע׃

controles.web: I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.
controles.kjv: I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy.
controles.livre: Não aprendi sabedoria, nem tenho conhecimento do Santo Deus .

versos.hebraico: מִ֤י עָלָֽה־שָׁמַ֨יִם׀ וַיֵּרַ֡ד מִ֤י אָֽסַף־ר֨וּחַ׀ בְּחָפְנָ֡יו מִ֤י צָֽרַר־מַ֨יִם׀ בַּשִּׂמְלָ֗ה מִ֭י הֵקִ֣ים כָּל־אַפְסֵי־אָ֑רֶץ מַה־שְּׁמ֥וֹ וּמַֽה־שֶּׁם־בְּ֝נ֗וֹ כִּ֣י תֵדָֽע׃

controles.web: Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?
controles.kjv: Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended? who hath gathered the wind in his fists? who hath bound the waters in a garment? who hath established all the ends of the earth? what is his name, and what is his son’s name, if thou canst tell?
controles.livre: Quem subiu ao céu, e desceu? Quem juntou os ventos com suas mãos? Quem amarrou as águas numa capa? Quem estabeleceu todos os limites da terra? Qual é o seu nome? e qual é o nome de seu filho, se tu o sabes?

versos.hebraico: כָּל־אִמְרַ֣ת אֱל֣וֹהַּ צְרוּפָ֑ה מָגֵ֥ן ה֝֗וּא לַֽחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
controles.kjv: Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
controles.livre: Toda palavra de Deus é pura; é escudo para os que nele confiam.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תּ֥וֹסְףְּ עַל־דְּבָרָ֑יו פֶּן־יוֹכִ֖יחַ בְּךָ֣ וְנִכְזָֽבְתָּ׃פ

controles.web: Don’t you add to his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.
controles.kjv: Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.
controles.livre: Nada acrescentes às suas palavras, para que ele não te repreenda, e sejas mostrado como mentiroso.

versos.hebraico: שְׁ֭תַּיִם שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵאִתָּ֑ךְ אַל־תִּמְנַ֥ע מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי בְּטֶ֣רֶם אָמֽוּת׃

controles.web: “Two things I have asked of you; don’t deny me before I die:
controles.kjv: Two things have I required of thee; deny me them not before I die:
controles.livre: Duas coisas eu te pedi; não as negues a mim antes que eu morra.

versos.hebraico: שָׁ֤וְא׀ וּֽדְבַר־כָּזָ֡ב הַרְחֵ֬ק מִמֶּ֗נִּי רֵ֣אשׁ וָ֭עֹשֶׁר אַל־תִּֽתֶּן־לִ֑י הַ֝טְרִיפֵ֗נִי לֶ֣חֶם חֻקִּֽי׃

controles.web: Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me;
controles.kjv: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:
controles.livre: Afasta de mim a inutilidade e palavra mentirosa; e não me dês nem pobreza nem riqueza, mantém-me com o pão que me for necessário.

versos.hebraico: פֶּ֥ן אֶשְׂבַּ֨ע׀ וְכִחַשְׁתִּי֮ וְאָמַ֗רְתִּי מִ֥י יְה֫וָ֥ה וּפֶֽן־אִוָּרֵ֥שׁ וְגָנַ֑בְתִּי וְ֝תָפַ֗שְׂתִּי שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהָֽי׃פ

controles.web: lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is Yahweh?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.
controles.kjv: Lest I be full, and deny thee, and say, Who is the Lord? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my God in vain.
controles.livre: Para que não aconteça de eu ficar farto e te negar, dizendo: Quem é o SENHOR?Nem também que eu empobreça, e venha a furtar, e desonre o nome do meu Deus.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תַּלְשֵׁ֣ן עֶ֭בֶד אֶל־אדנו פֶּֽן־יְקַלֶּלְךָ֥ וְאָשָֽׁמְתָּ׃

controles.web: “Don’t slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.
controles.kjv: Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.
controles.livre: Não difames do servo ao seu senhor, para que ele não te amaldiçoe e fiques culpado.

versos.hebraico: דּ֭וֹר אָבִ֣יו יְקַלֵּ֑ל וְאֶת־אִ֝מּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְבָרֵֽךְ׃

controles.web: There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.
controles.kjv: There is a generation that curseth their father, and doth not bless their mother.
controles.livre: Há gente que amaldiçoa a seu pai e não bendiz à sua mãe;

versos.hebraico: דּ֭וֹר טָה֣וֹר בְּעֵינָ֑יו וּ֝מִצֹּאָת֗וֹ לֹ֣א רֻחָֽץ׃

controles.web: There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.
controles.kjv: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet is not washed from their filthiness.
controles.livre: Há gente que é pura aos seus próprios olhos, mas que não foi lavada de sua imundície;

versos.hebraico: דּ֭וֹר מָה־רָמ֣וּ עֵינָ֑יו וְ֝עַפְעַפָּ֗יו יִנָּשֵֽׂאוּ׃

controles.web: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.
controles.kjv: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.
controles.livre: Há gente cujos olhos são arrogantes, e cujas sobrancelhas são levantadas;

versos.hebraico: דּ֤וֹר׀ חֲרָב֣וֹת שִׁנָּיו֮ וּֽמַאֲכָל֪וֹת מְֽתַלְּעֹ֫תָ֥יו לֶאֱכֹ֣ל עֲנִיִּ֣ים מֵאֶ֑רֶץ וְ֝אֶבְיוֹנִ֗ים מֵאָדָֽם׃פ

controles.web: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.
controles.kjv: There is a generation, whose teeth are as swords, and their jaw teeth as knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.
controles.livre: Há gente cujos dentes são espadas, e cujos queixos são facas, para devorarem aos aflitos da terra aos aflitos, e aos necessitados dentre os homens.

versos.hebraico: לַֽעֲלוּקָ֨ה׀ שְׁתֵּ֥י בָנוֹת֮ הַ֤ב׀ הַ֥ב שָׁל֣וֹשׁ הֵ֭נָּה לֹ֣א תִשְׂבַּ֑עְנָה אַ֝רְבַּ֗ע לֹא־אָ֥מְרוּ הֽוֹן׃

controles.web: “The leach has two daughters: ‘Give, give.’   “There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don’t say, ‘Enough:’
controles.kjv: The horseleach hath two daughters, crying, Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, yea, four things say not, It is enough:
controles.livre: A sanguessuga tem duas filhas: “Dá” e “Dá”; estas três coisas nunca se fartam, e quatro nunca dizem “É o suficiente”:

versos.hebraico: שְׁאוֹל֮ וְעֹ֪צֶ֫ר רָ֥חַם אֶ֭רֶץ לֹא־שָׂ֣בְעָה מַּ֑יִם וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ לֹא־אָ֥מְרָה הֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Sheol, the barren womb; the earth that is not satisfied with water; and the fire that doesn’t say, ‘Enough.’
controles.kjv: The grave; and the barren womb; the earth that is not filled with water; and the fire that saith not, It is enough.
controles.livre: O mundo dos mortos, o ventre feminino estéril, a terra que não se farta de água, e o fogo que nunca diz estar satisfeito.

versos.hebraico: עַ֤יִן׀ תִּֽלְעַ֣ג לְאָב֮ וְתָב֪וּז לִֽיקֲּהַ֫ת־אֵ֥ם יִקְּר֥וּהָ עֹרְבֵי־נַ֑חַל וְֽיֹאכְל֥וּהָ בְנֵי־נָֽשֶׁר׃פ

controles.web: “The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother: the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the young eagles shall eat it.
controles.kjv: The eye that mocketh at his father, and despiseth to obey his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.
controles.livre: Os olhos que zombam do pai ou desprezam obedecer à mãe, os corvos do riacho os arrancarão, e os filhotes de abutre os comerão.

versos.hebraico: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה הֵ֭מָּה נִפְלְא֣וּ מִמֶּ֑נִּי וארבע לֹ֣א יְדַעְתִּֽים׃

controles.web: “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand:
controles.kjv: There be three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:
controles.livre: Estas três coisas me maravilham, e quatro que não entendo:

versos.hebraico: דֶּ֤רֶךְ הַנֶּ֨שֶׁר׀ בַּשָּׁמַיִם֮ דֶּ֥רֶךְ נָחָ֗שׁ עֲלֵ֫י צ֥וּר דֶּֽרֶךְ־אֳנִיָּ֥ה בְלֶב־יָ֑ם וְדֶ֖רֶךְ גֶּ֣בֶר בְּעַלְמָֽה׃

controles.web: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent on a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maiden.
controles.kjv: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maid.
controles.livre: O caminho da águia no céu, o caminho da serpente na rocha, o caminho do navio no meio do mar, e o caminho do homem com uma moça.

versos.hebraico: כֵּ֤ן׀ דֶּ֥רֶךְ אִשָּׁ֗ה מְנָ֫אָ֥פֶת אָ֭כְלָה וּמָ֣חֲתָה פִ֑יהָ וְ֝אָמְרָ֗ה לֹֽא־פָעַ֥לְתִּי אָֽוֶן׃פ

controles.web: “So is the way of an adulterous woman: she eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’
controles.kjv: Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.
controles.livre: Assim é o caminho da mulher adúltera: ela come, limpa sua boca, e diz: Não fiz mal algum.

versos.hebraico: תַּ֣חַת שָׁ֭לוֹשׁ רָ֣גְזָה אֶ֑רֶץ וְתַ֥חַת אַ֝רְבַּ֗ע לֹא־תוּכַ֥ל שְׂאֵֽת׃

controles.web: “For three things the earth tremble, and under four, it can’t bear up:
controles.kjv: For three things the earth is disquieted, and for four which it cannot bear:
controles.livre: Por três coisas a terra se alvoroça, e por quatro que não pode suportar:

versos.hebraico: תַּֽחַת־עֶ֭בֶד כִּ֣י יִמְל֑וֹךְ וְ֝נָבָ֗ל כִּ֣י יִֽשְׂבַּֽע־לָֽחֶם׃

controles.web: For a servant when he is king; a fool when he is filled with food;
controles.kjv: For a servant when he reigneth; and a fool when he is filled with meat;
controles.livre: Pelo servo que governa como rei; pelo tolo que se enche de comida;

versos.hebraico: תַּ֣חַת שְׂ֭נוּאָה כִּ֣י תִבָּעֵ֑ל וְ֝שִׁפְחָ֗ה כִּֽי־תִירַ֥שׁ גְּבִרְתָּֽהּ׃פ

controles.web: for an unloved woman when she is married; and a handmaid who is heir to her mistress.
controles.kjv: For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.
controles.livre: Pela mulher odiada, quando se casa; e pela serva quando toma o lugar de sua senhora.

versos.hebraico: אַרְבָּ֣עָה הֵ֭ם קְטַנֵּי־אָ֑רֶץ וְ֝הֵ֗מָּה חֲכָמִ֥ים מְחֻכָּמִֽים׃

controles.web: “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:
controles.kjv: There be four things which are little upon the earth, but they are exceeding wise:
controles.livre: Estas quatro coisas são pequenas sobre a terra, porém muito sábias:

versos.hebraico: הַ֭נְּמָלִים עַ֣ם לֹא־עָ֑ז וַיָּכִ֖ינוּ בַקַּ֣יִץ לַחְמָֽם׃

controles.web: the ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.
controles.kjv: The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;
controles.livre: As formigas não são criaturas fortes, mas no verão preparam sua comida;

versos.hebraico: שְׁ֭פַנִּים עַ֣ם לֹא־עָצ֑וּם וַיָּשִׂ֖ימוּ בַסֶּ֣לַע בֵּיתָֽם׃

controles.web: The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.
controles.kjv: The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;
controles.livre: Os roedores  são um “povo” fraco, mas fazem suas casas nas rochas;

versos.hebraico: מֶ֭לֶךְ אֵ֣ין לָאַרְבֶּ֑ה וַיֵּצֵ֖א חֹצֵ֣ץ כֻּלּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks.
controles.kjv: The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;
controles.livre: Os gafanhotos não têm rei; mas todos saem em bandos;

versos.hebraico: שְׂ֭מָמִית בְּיָדַ֣יִם תְּתַפֵּ֑שׂ וְ֝הִ֗יא בְּהֵ֣יכְלֵי מֶֽלֶךְ׃פ

controles.web: You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.
controles.kjv: The spider taketh hold with her hands, and is in kings’ palaces.
controles.livre: As lagartixas podem ser pegas com as mãos, e mesmo assim estão nos palácios dos reis.

versos.hebraico: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה הֵ֭מָּה מֵיטִ֣יבֵי צָ֑עַד וְ֝אַרְבָּעָ֗ה מֵיטִ֥בֵי לָֽכֶת׃

controles.web: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:
controles.kjv: There be three things which go well, yea, four are comely in going:
controles.livre: Estes três tem um bom andar, e quatro que se movem muito bem:

versos.hebraico: לַ֭יִשׁ גִּבּ֣וֹר בַּבְּהֵמָ֑ה וְלֹא־יָ֝שׁ֗וּב מִפְּנֵי־כֹֽל׃

controles.web: The lion, which is mightiest among animals, and doesn’t turn away for any;
controles.kjv: A lion which is strongest among beasts, and turneth not away for any;
controles.livre: O leão, forte entre os animais, que não foge de ninguém;

versos.hebraico: זַרְזִ֣יר מָתְנַ֣יִם אוֹ־תָ֑יִשׁ וּ֝מֶ֗לֶךְ אַלְק֥וּם עִמּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: the greyhound, the male goat also; and the king against whom there is no rising up.
controles.kjv: A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom there is no rising up.
controles.livre: O galo, o bode, e o rei com seu exército.

versos.hebraico: אִם־נָבַ֥לְתָּ בְהִתְנַשֵּׂ֑א וְאִם־זַ֝מּ֗וֹתָ יָ֣ד לְפֶֽה׃

controles.web: “If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.
controles.kjv: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if thou hast thought evil, lay thine hand upon thy mouth.
controles.livre: Se agiste como tolo, exaltando-te, e se planejaste o mal, põe tua mão sobre a boca;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י מִ֪יץ חָלָ֡ב י֘וֹצִ֤יא חֶמְאָ֗ה וּֽמִיץ־אַ֭ף י֣וֹצִיא דָ֑ם וּמִ֥יץ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם י֣וֹצִיא רִֽיב׃פ

controles.web: For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood; so the forcing of wrath produces strife.”
controles.kjv: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood: so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.
controles.livre: Porque como o forçar do leite produz manteiga, e o forçar do nariz produz sangue, assim também o forçar da ira produz briga.
